test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He hasn’t _______ any attention to my miserable state.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The verb** "paid"** is commonly used with the noun "attention" to indicate the act of noticing or considering something.
 
• The other options do not fit grammatically or contextually with the noun **"attention".**
 
• Therefore,** "He hasn’t paid any attention to my miserable state"** is the correct and grammatically appropriate sentence.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "gave"** – The verb** "gave" **does not correctly combine with **"attention"** in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "had"** – The verb **"had"** is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "made"** – The verb **"made" **does not correctly fit with** "attention".**
